United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)

title.narrative: Strengthening the management of Biosphere Reserves and Global Geoparks and promoting innovative financing solutions in Argentina, Bolivia, Paraguay and Uruguay

description.narrative: The activities will support the nomination, effective management and sustainable development of Biosphere Reserves and Global Geoparks by strengthening Member States’ capacities in line with UNESCO’s international standards. Technical assistance will be provided for the preparation of high-quality nomination dossiers and for enhancing inclusive and sustainable territorial governance. Scientific tools and knowledge will be promoted to inform conservation, monitoring and decision-making processes, generating evidence-based inputs for public policies at local, national and regional levels. Socio-economic assessments will support strategic planning and the integration of Biosphere Reserves and Global Geoparks into local development strategies. Innovative financial mechanisms will be identified to support biodiversity conservation, inclusive climate adaptation, regenerative production and sustainable value chains, contributing to improved livelihoods and well-being of local and indigenous communities.
